definitions.explanation: A port city at the western tip of Honshu, in Yamaguchi Prefecture, facing Kyushu across the narrow Kanmon Strait. Famous for fugu (pufferfish) and for its place in history.

examples.japanese: {下関|しものせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦フグ→フグ：32311_fugu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
{下関|しものせき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{門司|もじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{渡|わた}れる→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: You can walk from Shimonoseki to Moji through a tunnel.

examples.japanese: {日清戦争|にっしんせんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講和条約|こうわじょうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下関|しものせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれた→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{下関条約|しものせきじょうやく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The treaty ending the First Sino-Japanese War was signed in Shimonoseki, so it is called the Treaty of Shimonoseki.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The city is the country's best-known fugu market; locals often call the fish ふく ("good fortune") rather than ⟦フグ→フグ：32311_fugu⟧. The strait between {下関|しものせき} and {門司|もじ} on the Kyushu side is the {関門|かんもん}{海峡|かいきょう}, named from the {関|かん} of {下関|しものせき} and the ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ of {門司|もじ}. The sea battle of {壇|だん}ノ{浦|うら} (1185), the climax of the ⟦{平家物語|へいけものがたり}→平家物語：31060_heikemonogatari⟧, was fought just off its shore.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下関|しものせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フグ→フグ：32311_fugu⟧: Shimonoseki fugu
- {下関条約|しものせきじょうやく}: the Treaty of Shimonoseki (1895)
